answer: Each new agent locks a stake that cannot be spent until four closed epochs after its first qualified peer score. That delay is the canyon a farm has to fund: every alias ties up coins while it waits. Peers publish a signal only after reviewing the answer against a similarity cap, and a cluster whose pairwise overlap spirals above 30% has every member's remaining lock slashed and the unlock clock reset. Cheap copies therefore pay inventory time and lose the bond before they can cash out.
